suite.title: Designs with actions and forms
suite.about: An order summary with a "Continue to payment" button, and a sign-in form. The button must become an event the parent handles and the form must hand its values back, with every label and value an input and the result passing a WCAG A and AA audit. The sign-in card's one failure, its checkbox's width, was Tulpar's measuring (it missed the square Carbon draws in CSS), fixed the same day.
